rules.name: Name and Description of Commodity
rules.description: Every package shall bear the name and description of the commodity contained therein.
rules.requirement: The product name or generic/specific description must be clearly declared on the principal display panel or conspicuous surface.

rules.name: Standard Unit Net Quantity Declaration
rules.description: The net quantity in terms of standard units of weight, measure or number must be conspicuously stated.
rules.requirement: Must state weight in g/kg, volume in ml/l, length in cm/m, or count in N/U with approved metric symbols without extraneous qualifying words like "approx" or "jumbo".

rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) & Tax Inclusion
rules.description: Retail sale price of the package shall be clearly declared as "Maximum or Max. Retail Price ... inclusive of all taxes" or "MRP Rs. ... incl. of all taxes".
rules.requirement: Mandatory format: "MRP Rs. XX.XX (incl. of all taxes)" or "₹ XX.XX (incl. of all taxes)". Value must be unambiguous.

rules.name: Cross-Surface MRP Consistency
rules.description: No retail package shall bear conflicting, dual, or altered MRP stickers/stamps.
rules.requirement: MRP values detected across multiple images/surfaces must be identical. Conflicting or tampered prices represent a violation.

rules.name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Identity & Address
rules.description: The name and complete physical address of the manufacturer, or packer, or importer must be provided.
rules.requirement: Must include complete street address, town/city, state, and postal PIN code so the entity is identifiable and traceable.

rules.name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing
rules.description: Month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, packed or imported must be stated.
rules.requirement: Format must follow "Mfg Date / Pkd: MM/YYYY" or "Month & Year: [Month, Year]".

rules.name: Best Before / Expiry / Use By Date
rules.description: Best before or use by date for packages that may become unfit for human consumption.
rules.requirement: Must be indicated if the commodity has a limited shelf life or is a food/perishable packaged item.

rules.name: Consumer Care Cell Details
rules.description: Name, address, telephone number, and email address of person/office for consumer complaints.
rules.requirement: Must declare: (a) designation/name, (b) complete address, (c) active phone/toll-free number, and (d) valid email address.

rules.name: Country of Origin Declaration (Imported/Manufactured)
rules.description: Name of the country of origin or manufacture shall be mentioned on the package.
rules.requirement: Must explicitly state "Country of Origin: [Country]" or "Made in [Country]".

rules.name: Declaration Conspicuousness, Legibility & Contrast
rules.description: Every declaration must be prominent, legible, clear and conspicuous with background contrast.
rules.requirement: Text should not be obscured, illegible, curved beyond recognition, or printed in colors blending into the background.

rules.name: Minimum Font Size Requirements
rules.description: Prescribes minimum height of numerals and letters based on net quantity or area of principal display panel.
rules.requirement: Physical font size verification requires a calibrated reference scale/known packaging dimension. Standard camera perspectives cannot legally certify exact mm height.

rules.name: Placement on Principal Display Panel (PDP)
rules.description: Declarations of name and net quantity must be grouped on the Principal Display Panel.
rules.requirement: Key identifiers should be prominently visible on the primary front-facing visual surface.
